text: デッキ　そうじは　らくじゃねえぜ

patterns.name: 〜じゃない
patterns.explanation: じゃない means 'is not'. じゃねえ is a rough, slurred way of saying it, typical of tough men. らくじゃねえ = 'ain't easy'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, manly way to push a statement at the listener. らくじゃねえぜ = 'it ain't easy, I tell you'.
